high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Bloomberg.com, as indicated by the URL at the top. The content discusses a luxury retail and dining destination called "Royalmount" being developed by L Catterton in Montreal. This project involves rehabbing a light industrial district and will anchor a $5.1 billion development that includes various LVMH brands. The development will be connected to a metro station via a $37 million pedestrian walkway. The article highlights the competitive landscape for luxury brands, particularly those not affiliated with LVMH.
